author: DaFrozenBlaze
body: There are times where Avicus' player count gets really low. Some maps need like 4 players on a team in order to start, and with a small player count sometimes, these maps will never start and people will just leave. I say reduce the number of players needed for all maps to maybe a 2v2 or something like that.

replies.author: SamuelJacob9
replies.body: Yes, But this shouldn't happen because last year (Early 2015) There was never a game like this. Yesterday, I saw 4 people online. 4! That isn't even enough to start a DTM game. They either have to get more players or, do what Blaze said, add 2v2 maps instead of 4v4.
